item.title: Tonight: ‘Hour with the Rebbe’ From 770
item.description: Thousands of Bochurim from 56 Yeshivos are expected to join together in 770 Eastern Parkway on Yud Shevat for the highly anticipated 14th Annual “Hour with the Rebbe” program. Full Story

item.title: Shifra & Puah Campaign Reaches Peak on Yud Shvat, Raffle for Rebbe’s Dollar
item.description: As the Jewish world marks 75 years of the Rebbe’s leadership, the annual campaign for Shifra & Puah of Crown Heights is reaching its peak. Full Story, Video

item.title: From Reb Levi Yitzchok: Two Levels of Faith
item.description: Insights from Toras Harav Levi Yitzchok Schneerson, the Rebbe's father, presented by Shliach Rabbi Dovid Dubov of New Jersey, for Beshalach: Two levels of faith. Full Story, Video

item.title: Live: Yud Shevat Farbrengen With Rabbi YY Jacobson
item.description: Live Wednesday at 8:30 PM ET: Join a Yud Shevat Farbrengen with Rabbi YY Jacobson, music by Ben Shimon live from Monsey, NY. Live

item.title: Live: Yud Shvat Farbrengen With Rabbi Yossi Rosenblum
item.description: Join Live at 8:30 PM ET: Join a Farbrengen in honor of Yud Shevat with Rabbi Yossi Rosenblum of Pittsburgh, PA, hosted at Bais Shmuel Chabad in Crown Heights. Live

item.title: NOW: Rabbi Osher Farkash Fabrengs for Bochurim
item.description: The Vaad Talmidei Hatmimim is hosting a central Yud Shevat Farbrengen for Bochurim tonight for Yud Shevat in English, led by Rabbi Osher Farkash, Mashpia in Argentina, and will be in English. All bochurim are invited to join now at Oholei Torah. Full Story

item.title: Putin Hears About Yud Shevat During Meeting with Rabbis
item.description: President Vladimir Putin shared memories of his Chassidic neighbor after hearing about the special Chassidic date of Yud Shevat in a meeting with Chief Rabbi Berel Lazar. Full Story

item.title: Car Rams Into Entrance of 770 Eastern Parkway
item.description: A car rammed into one of the entrances of 770 Eastern Parkway Chabad Headquarters on Wednesday evening. NYPD and emergency crews are on the scene. Full Story

item.title: Mayor Mamdani Visits 770 After Ramming Attack
item.description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani, joined by NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch and and NYS Attorney General Tish James, visited 770 Eastern Parkway on Wednesday in the aftermath of a ramming attack on the building of Chabad Headquarters in Crown Heights. Full Story

item.title: NYPD, Mayor Give Update on 770 Ramming Attack
item.description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani, NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch and and NYS Attorney General Tish James provided an update on the investigation into a ramming attack on Wednesday at 770 Eastern Parkway, Chabad Headquarters. Video
